thread:
mina: bringing up mappa-v0.1 int8 on staging for a multilingual smoke test. zh->en shortctx translations look noisier than fp16. anyone else seeing token counts drop?
cheng: can you paste a minimal repro and which quant path (q4/q5/int8) you're using?
mina: using int8 build from onboarding script. example input: '今天下午开会' -> model output truncated: 'This afternoon ' and tokenization sometimes shows 3->2 tokens. log snippet: ```detok: 今天下午开会\ntokens_host: ['今天','下午','开会']\ntokens_runtime: ['今天','下午开会']```
liam: that subtoken merge looks like a tokenizer/runtime mismatch or a decode-time prefix join. also could be kv_cache + sampling interacting. are you sampling or greedy?
mina: sampling on (`top_p=0.92`, `temp=0.9`), batch 1, kv_cache enabled. ran with `--quantize int8` during bring-up.
jess: quick checklist: 1) tokenizer parity host vs runtime (`scripts/tokenizer_parity.py`) 2) decode with kv_cache off 3) compare NFC normalization. can you run those?
mina: ran parity: host vs runtime mismatch ~0.12% on a CJK corpus. snippet: ```host_tokens: ["今天","下午","开会"] runtime_tokens: ["今天","下午开会"]``` so runtime merges the last two subtokens occasionally.
cheng: 0.12% is significant for short sentences. any normalization differences (NFC/NFD)? Also check `strip_spaces` pretokenizer flag — we changed it earlier for perf.
mina: we normalize to NFC upstream. noticed runtime pretokenizer uses `strip_spaces=false` due to micro-opt; i'll rerun with `strip_spaces=true`.
liam: also try disabling kv_cache to rule out kvcache key aliasing caused by quant rounding. command: `python run_onboard.py --no-kv-cache --quantize int8 --input "今天下午开会"`
mina: quick A/B: disabling kv_cache -> tokens stable and translations match fp16. re-enabling kv_cache + lowering temp to 0.3 -> much less drift. hypothesis: sampling amplifies tiny quant rounding differences in kvcache keys, leading to different subtoken boundaries. :thinking:
jess: good triage. proposed next steps: 1) run deterministic greedy with kv_cache on/off 2) collect per-step kvcache key hashes and sizes 3) bisect quantization (int8 -> q5 -> fp16) to find threshold. I can own the bisect run. :thumbsup:
mina: thanks — please own bisect. I'll attach run IDs and the small eval set (500 zh->en shortctx samples) and collect kvcache hashes.
deploy-bot: archive created: staging/mappa-v0.1/int8/run-1749994321. logs uploaded -> https://internal.storage/runs/1749994321 :thumbsup:
cheng: if bisect points to quant kernel, we should add a targeted tokenization smoke in onboard CI that exercises kv_cache + sampling for CJK shortctx. agree?
jess: agree — adding a tiny CI step that runs 50 shortctx CJK samples with kv_cache on + sampling and checks tokenizer parity. i'll open PR after bisect results.
mina: i'll post run artifacts and a short notebook showing the hash diffs. thanks all. :eyes:
